title: imap DB migration: uid_validity and imap_flags tables
description: Create crates/imap/migrations/20260423000001_imap_state.sql. Tables: (1) CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS imap_uid_validity (group_name TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, uidvalidity INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, next_uid INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1); -- UIDVALIDITY is a stable u32 per mailbox; next_uid is the next UID to assign (monotonically increasing). (2) CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS imap_flags (user_id TEXT NOT NULL, group_name TEXT NOT NULL, cid TEXT NOT NULL, flags TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', PRIMARY KEY (user_id, group_name, cid)); -- flags is a space-separated list of IMAP flag names (\Seen, \Flagged, \Answered, \Deleted, \Draft, plus user keywords). CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_imap_flags_user_group ON imap_flags (user_id, group_name);. Create crates/imap/src/migrations.rs with pub async fn run_migrations(pool: &SqlitePool) -> Result<(), sqlx::Error> using sqlx::migrate\!('./migrations').
